CustomField.description: Used to be picked up to get placed in the Roll 3 months data back to an Account Returns TRUE for time entries within the previous three completed calendar months. Used for TechOps rolling three-month overage calculations billed in arrears. Excludes the current month until it is complete.
CustomField.formula:
/* Rolling 3-Month Window (Completed Months Only)
Purpose: Include time entries from the previous three COMPLETED calendar months. This is used for TechOps overage calculations that are billed in arrears.
Examples: - During July → Includes April, May, June - During August → Includes May, June, July - During January → Includes October, November, December
Start Date: First day of three months ago (inclusive)
End Date: First day of the current month (exclusive) */
AND( /* Start on the first day of the month three months ago */ Time_Entry_Date__c >= ADDMONTHS( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), -3 ),
/* Stop before the first day of the current month */ Time_Entry_Date__c < DATE( YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1 ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Returns TRUE for time entries within the previous three completed calendar months. Used for TechOps rolling three-month overage calculations billed in arrears. Excludes the current month until it is complete.
CustomField.label: Rolling 3 Month
